data.product: Halcyon is appointment scheduling for veterinary clinics. Pet owners book and change visits online. Each clinic gets a confirmed day sheet per vet and room, and reminders go out by text and email with one tap to confirm or reschedule. It reads the schedule from the clinic's practice management system. Setup takes about two weeks per clinic. Pricing is shared on the call.

stories.quote: Our front desk used to spend the morning calling people who forgot. Now most of them confirm with one tap.

hero.headline: Full waiting rooms, fewer empty appointment slots.
hero.sub: Halcyon gives Cedar Hollow's five clinics one schedule that owners can book and change themselves, with a reminder that confirms in one tap. Your front desks spend less of the day on the phone.

noticed.fact: Five clinics, each with its own phone number and its own booking link.
The fifth clinic, in Hillsboro, opened in August.
Open roles for front desk coordinators at two clinics.

data.uses_lead: Picked for the team that runs scheduling across five clinics, from the clinics page, the Hillsboro news and the careers page.

uses.title: One schedule for five clinics
uses.today: Each clinic has its own phone number and booking link, so an owner has to pick a clinic before they can pick a time.
uses.after: One booking page shows open times at every clinic, and a visit moves between clinics without a phone call.

uses.title: Fewer missed appointments
uses.today: Reminders depend on what each front desk has time for on a busy morning.
uses.after: Every visit gets a text and an email, and the owner confirms or reschedules with one tap. The clinic sees who has confirmed.

uses.title: A calmer front desk
uses.today: Two clinics are hiring front desk coordinators, and much of their day goes to booking and calling.
uses.after: Owners book and change visits online, so the desk spends its time on the people in the room.

data.rollout_lead: Start with one clinic, then add the other four, so the front desks learn it on one schedule before it reaches all five.

rollout.title: Connect one clinic
rollout.body: We read the schedule from the clinic's practice management system and set up its vets, rooms and visit types.

rollout.title: Open online booking
rollout.body: Owners start booking and confirming online. The front desk keeps the phone and sees every change on the day sheet.

rollout.title: Add the other clinics
rollout.body: One clinic every two weeks, with the first clinic's front desk showing the next one how it works.

faq.q: Do we have to change our practice management system?
faq.a: No. Halcyon reads the schedule from it, and clinics keep using it for records and billing.

faq.q: What happens when an owner cannot make a visit?
faq.a: They tap reschedule in the reminder, pick another open time, and the clinic's day sheet updates.

faq.q: How long does setup take for each clinic?
faq.a: About two weeks per clinic. We start with one and add the others after.
We share pricing on the call, so you see it next to the plan for five clinics.
